login.headline: Your salon's back office
login.lead: Your whole day in one place: schedule, clients, till and activity.

highlights.calendar: The schedule for the day and the week
highlights.users: Client records and the salon team
highlights.card: Front-desk checkout, by card or in cash

login.title: Back office — sign in

session-expiree.title: Your session has expired
session-expiree.body: Sign in again to pick up where you left off.

renouvellement-indisponible.title: Session not renewed for now
renouvellement-indisponible.body: You have not been signed out: renewing your session did not go through just now. Try again in a few seconds.

unreachable.title: Service unavailable
unreachable.message: The service is temporarily unreachable. Please try again in a moment.

throttled.title: Too many attempts
throttled.message: Too many sign-in attempts in a short time. Wait a minute before trying again.

noAccess.title: No back-office screen for this account
noAccess.closed: The back office opens no section for you, and the session has just been closed. Your appointments are available from your client area.
noAccess.stillOpen: The back office opens no section for you. The session could not be closed: close this tab, or sign out from your client area, where your appointments are available.

invitation.headline: Welcome to your back office
invitation.lead: Choose your password: you will land straight in your workspace.

highlights.store: Your services, your opening hours and your storefront
highlights.users: Your team and your client records

invitation.title: Activate your account
invitation.mismatch: the two passwords do not match

missingToken.title: Incomplete link
missingToken.body: This link carries no activation code. Open the full link you received, without shortening it.

invitation.expiredLink: This activation link is no longer valid: it has expired, or it has already been used. Ask for a new link from the person who sent it to you — or, if your account is already active, sign in.

error.title: Screen unavailable
error.noticeTitle: This screen could not be displayed
error.noticeMessage: An unexpected error interrupted this screen. Try again in a moment.

guard.unreachable: The salon server is temporarily unreachable. Try again in a moment.
